$comment: The register of released wavelength-rules sets (NP-NPPS-REF-001 §7a.1, OI-WRV-01, SWR-HV-03): one row per released set, append-only, newest last. `hash` is the SHA-256 of the set's canonical form (common/npps-core/src/wavelength_version.rs), which the core computes and nobody assigns. NeurOne assigns `version` (major.minor) when it ships a set. A row is never edited, removed or reused, and a version never goes down. The last row is the shipped file protocols/predefined/00-wavelength-rules.npps; common/npps-core/tests/wavelength_version.rs fails when it is not.
